title: DOCTOR WHO
subtitle: Across the Eras
blurb: Twenty years of the revived series, from Rose to the Rani. Pick a Doctor, a companion, a showrunner, a big bad, an arc or a vibe — and find the episodes to rewatch.
regularsNote: The Doctor and the current TARDIS team are series regulars and aren't listed per-episode — this dropdown is guest cast only, so it's the place to find Jackie, Wilf, Kate Stewart, Osgood, Davros, the Master, the Paternoster Gang and every one-story guest.
credits: Revived series only (2005– ). Episode data via TVmaze (shows 210 and 72724); chart hand-built for this project.
chartHint: Click any bar to filter episodes by that era. Click a season number to filter by season. Shift-click to combine.
